title: Error hint shows env var when one doesn't exist
root_cause_summary: get_error_hint() in Option class did not check whether envvar is None before including it in the error message. Added guard: `if self.show_envvar and self.envvar is not None`.
notes: File path in issue (click-test.py) is a user script not tracked by git. MENTIONED_FILES will be empty. But errors.txt will have quoted strings and Error Sources will find envvar-related code in core.py.
